metadata.description: Analytic accounting: correct ORM fields and group-by patterns

module.name: analytic_lines
module.description: Main model for analytic entries. Each line has an amount, date and account.

fields.field: Many2one → account.analytic.group (analytic group of the account)
Reference code of the analytic account

rules.rule: To group by analytic group: query account.analytic.line, then access account_id.group_id on each line.
Income = lines with amount > 0. Expenses = lines with amount < 0. Balance = sum(amount).
Date filter: use 'date' field on account.analytic.line directly.
Apply the 3-tier color convention by default to any result that includes a balance or total column, even if the user does not explicitly request colors.

pattern.name: group_by_analytic_group
pattern.description: Sum income, expenses and balance per analytic group
